She developed Stiff-Person syndrome (SPS) with high muscle tone and difficult neuropsychiatric symptoms within 3 years.
After 3 years the patient suffered from a progressive stiffness ... A severe startle reaction could be triggered by unexpected noises and tactile stimuli.
